Figure 7:Cross-harness consistency on AgentDrawBench. (a–c) Prompt-matched layout correlation, palette cosine similarity, and DreamSim distance between independent drawings of the same prompt using five harnesses and a second SVG run. (d–f) The same three metrics summarized by pair type. Drawings produced with Canvas 2D, SVG, and Shapes show cross-harness similarity close to that of two independent SVG runs. Mouse-driven GUI drawings show comparable similarity to these outputs. Blender drawings are less similar to the 2D outputs, but remain substantially more similar than drawings of different prompts.
